$comment: Candidate store screens, in store order. Every screen is a CAPTURE TARGET, not a design: the final PNG always embeds a real capture of the released native app (PR #287, not merged on 2026-09-29) running on synthetic fixture data. A screen may only be used for finals when `confirmed` is true, i.e. someone checked it exists in the merged native app and recorded how to reach it. Never invent UI to fill a slot: drop the slot instead.

release_gate.reason: The published app is the native DINCR app from #287. Store finals must show that UI, not the older Capacitor UI.

fixture.note: These hooks exist in the native prototype on main (debug builds only). Confirm the scenario names that the #287 app exposes before capturing.

screens.note: Only if the released app ships the mail review. Use a fixture mailbox such as ana.demo@example.com; never a real address or real mail content.
